# Flow Control Crash Course


Let's dive into flow control in C#. Since you know Dart, you'll find many similarities, but C# has some powerful features that Dart doesn't have.

## Overview


```
Flow Control in C#
│
├── Conditional Statements
│   ├── if/else/else if
│   ├── switch statement (traditional)
│   ├── switch expression (modern C# 8.0+)
│   └── ternary operator (?:)
│
├── Loops
│   ├── for loop
│   ├── foreach loop
│   ├── while loop
│   └── do-while loop
│
└── Jump Statements
    ├── break
    ├── continue
    ├── return
    └── goto (rarely used)
```

## Conditional Statements


### If/Else/Else If

Basic syntax (very similar to Dart):

```csharp
int age = 25;

if (age < 18)
{
    Console.WriteLine("Minor");
}
else if (age < 65)
{
    Console.WriteLine("Adult");
}
else
{
    Console.WriteLine("Senior");
}

// Single-line if (braces optional, but not recommended)
if (age >= 18) Console.WriteLine("Can vote");
```

### Ternary Operator

```csharp
string status = age >= 18 ? "Adult" : "Minor";

// Can be nested (but don't overdo it)
string category = age < 13 ? "Child" : age < 18 ? "Teen" : "Adult";
```

### Switch Statement (Traditional)


```csharp
int dayOfWeek = 3;

switch (dayOfWeek)
{
    case 1:
        Console.WriteLine("Monday");
        break;  // Required! Unlike Dart
    case 2:
        Console.WriteLine("Tuesday");
        break;
    case 3:
    case 4:
    case 5:
        Console.WriteLine("Midweek");
        break;
    default:
        Console.WriteLine("Weekend");
        break;
}
```

**Key difference from Dart**: C# requires explicit `break` statements (no implicit break like Dart).

### Switch Expression (Modern C# 8.0+) ⭐


This is one of C#'s most powerful features:

```csharp
// Basic switch expression
string dayName = dayOfWeek switch
{
    1 => "Monday",
    2 => "Tuesday",
    3 => "Wednesday",
    4 => "Thursday",
    5 => "Friday",
    6 => "Saturday",
    7 => "Sunday",
    _ => "Invalid"  // _ is the discard pattern (like default)
};

// Pattern matching with switch
string GetTemperatureDescription(int temp) => temp switch
{
    < 0 => "Freezing",
    >= 0 and < 15 => "Cold",
    >= 15 and < 25 => "Mild",
    >= 25 and < 35 => "Warm",
    >= 35 => "Hot",
    _ => "Unknown"
};

// Type pattern matching
string GetTypeDescription(object obj) => obj switch
{
    int i => $"Integer: {i}",
    string s => $"String: {s}",
    double d => $"Double: {d}",
    null => "Null value",
    _ => "Unknown type"
};
```

## Loops


### For Loop

```csharp
// Standard for loop (same as Dart)
for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++)
{
    Console.WriteLine($"Iteration {i}");
}

// Multiple variables
for (int i = 0, j = 10; i < j; i++, j--)
{
    Console.WriteLine($"i: {i}, j: {j}");
}

// Infinite loop
for (;;)
{
    // Do something
    break; // Don't forget to break!
}
```

### Foreach Loop


```csharp
int[] numbers = { 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 };

// Foreach - similar to Dart's for-in
foreach (int num in numbers)
{
    Console.WriteLine(num);
}

// With collections
List<string> names = new List<string> { "Alice", "Bob", "Charlie" };
foreach (string name in names)
{
    Console.WriteLine(name);
}

// var keyword (type inference)
foreach (var item in numbers)
{
    Console.WriteLine(item);
}
```

### While Loop

```csharp
int count = 0;
while (count < 5)
{
    Console.WriteLine($"Count: {count}");
    count++;
}

// Infinite while
while (true)
{
    // Do something
    if (someCondition) break;
}
```

### Do-While Loop


```csharp
// Executes at least once (same as Dart)
int i = 0;
do
{
    Console.WriteLine($"i: {i}");
    i++;
} while (i < 5);

// Useful for user input validation
string input;
do
{
    Console.Write("Enter 'yes' or 'no': ");
    input = Console.ReadLine();
} while (input != "yes" && input != "no");
```

## Jump Statements


### Break

```csharp
// Exit loop immediately
for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++)
{
    if (i == 5) break;
    Console.WriteLine(i);  // Prints 0-4
}

// In nested loops, break only exits the innermost loop
for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
{
    for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++)
    {
        if (j == 1) break;  // Only breaks inner loop
        Console.WriteLine($"i: {i}, j: {j}");
    }
}
```

### Continue

```csharp
// Skip current iteration
for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++)
{
    if (i == 2) continue;
    Console.WriteLine(i);  // Prints 0, 1, 3, 4 (skips 2)
}

// Skip even numbers
for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++)
{
    if (i % 2 == 0) continue;
    Console.WriteLine(i);  // Prints odd numbers only
}
```

### Return

```csharp
int FindFirst(int[] array, int target)
{
    for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
    {
        if (array[i] == target)
            return i;  // Exit method immediately
    }
    return -1;  // Not found
}
```

## Pattern Matching (C# 9.0+) ⭐⭐


C# has very powerful pattern matching that goes beyond what Dart offers:

```csharp
// Relational patterns
string GetAgeGroup(int age) => age switch
{
    < 13 => "Child",
    >= 13 and < 20 => "Teenager",
    >= 20 and < 60 => "Adult",
    >= 60 => "Senior",
    _ => throw new ArgumentException("Invalid age")
};

// Logical patterns (and, or, not)
bool IsWeekday(int day) => day is >= 1 and <= 5;
bool IsWeekend(int day) => day is 6 or 7;

// Property patterns
record Person(string Name, int Age);

string GetDiscount(Person person) => person switch
{
    { Age: < 18 } => "Child discount",
    { Age: >= 65 } => "Senior discount",
    { Name: "VIP" } => "VIP discount",
    _ => "No discount"
};

// Tuple patterns
string GetQuadrant(int x, int y) => (x, y) switch
{
    (0, 0) => "Origin",
    (> 0, > 0) => "Quadrant I",
    (< 0, > 0) => "Quadrant II",
    (< 0, < 0) => "Quadrant III",
    (> 0, < 0) => "Quadrant IV",
    (_, 0) => "X-axis",
    (0, _) => "Y-axis"
};
```

## Practical Example: Medical Imaging Workflow


Here's a practical example combining various flow control structures for a radiology scenario:

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

public class ImagingStudy
{
    public string Modality { get; set; }
    public string BodyPart { get; set; }
    public int Priority { get; set; }
    public bool IsUrgent { get; set; }
}

public class RadiologyWorkflow
{
    public static void ProcessStudies(List<ImagingStudy> studies)
    {
        // Sort by priority
        foreach (var study in studies)
        {
            // Early exit for urgent cases
            if (study.IsUrgent)
            {
                Console.WriteLine($"🚨 URGENT: {study.Modality} - {study.BodyPart}");
                continue;
            }

            // Pattern matching for routing
            string department = study.Modality switch
            {
                "CT" or "MRI" => "Cross-sectional",
                "XR" or "DX" => "Plain film",
                "US" => "Ultrasound",
                "MG" => "Mammography",
                _ => "General"
            };

            // Priority-based workflow
            string status = study.Priority switch
            {
                1 => "STAT - Read immediately",
                2 => "Urgent - Within 2 hours",
                3 => "Routine - Within 24 hours",
                _ => "Standard workflow"
            };

            Console.WriteLine($"Route to {department}: {study.BodyPart} ({status})");

            // AI processing based on modality and body part
            if (ShouldUseAI(study))
            {
                Console.WriteLine($"  → AI analysis triggered");
            }
        }
    }

    private static bool ShouldUseAI(ImagingStudy study) => (study.Modality, study.BodyPart) switch
    {
        ("CT", "Chest") => true,
        ("XR", "Chest") => true,
        ("MRI", "Brain") => true,
        _ => false
    };

    public static void Main()
    {
        var studies = new List<ImagingStudy>
        {
            new() { Modality = "CT", BodyPart = "Chest", Priority = 1, IsUrgent = true },
            new() { Modality = "XR", BodyPart = "Hand", Priority = 3, IsUrgent = false },
            new() { Modality = "MRI", BodyPart = "Brain", Priority = 2, IsUrgent = false }
        };

        ProcessStudies(studies);
    }
}
```

## Key Differences from Dart


| Feature | C# | Dart |
|---------|----|----|
| Switch break | Required | Implicit |
| Switch expression | ✅ Powerful | Limited |
| Pattern matching | ✅ Very advanced | Basic |
| foreach keyword | `foreach` | `for...in` |
| Type inference | `var` | `var` |
| Do-while | ✅ | ✅ |
